title: Photograph 6
passage: A. A book is partly underneath a folded blanket. B. A wicker basket has been set on the seat. C. Two cushions are propped against the back of the seat. D. The cushions are stacked one on top of the other.
passageZh:
A. 一本書有一部分壓在摺好的毯子下。
B. 座位上放了一個柳條籃。
C. 兩個靠墊立著靠在椅背上。
D. 兩個靠墊一個疊在另一個上面。
audioScript: A. A book is partly underneath a folded blanket. B. A wicker basket has been set on the seat. C. Two cushions are propped against the back of the seat. D. The cushions are stacked one on top of the other.
